cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Lose Something for Me
cards.instruction: Create a loyalty test by asking them to accept a real disadvantage on your behalf.

mechanism: Copy a finalist's rosette as theatre support, then demand that the finalist forfeit the award to prove loyalty by attending A's play.
confusable: Not an informed scheduling request alone: B2 must correct the copied badge meaning and A3 must confidently turn that correction into stronger pressure.
comparison: Loss of an earned award instead of one available admission ticket.
seedUse: Retains opening night versus receiving a prize; newly adds rosette confusion and explicit forfeiture.
